content: ggplot2 publication theme best practices 2025: (1) Create package-specific theme function (e.g. theme_eventstudy()) wrapping theme_minimal/theme_bw with brand colors, base_size, base_family. (2) Use ragg 1.5.2 + systemfonts 1.3.2 for font rendering; ragg_png device in knitr. (3) scales 1.4.0 for financial axis labels (percent, dollar, comma formatting). (4) patchwork 1.3.2 for multi-panel figures. (5) ggthemes 5.2.0 for Economist/WSJ themes if domain-specific look wanted. (6) Google Fonts via bslib/sysfonts for web-safe font consistency between pkgdown site and ggplot2 output. For report templates: set dev='ragg_png' globally in report Rmd knitr opts.
